answer: Each identity must post a bond held in escrow for 30 epochs and bind it to a hardware credential, with the bond record listing a canyon identifier that validators check per message. Forging 1,000 identities locks 2,000,000 units, and a proved sybil cluster slashes 100% of every linked bond. Copying a credential still costs one full bond per fake identity, and independent jurors trace shared bond headers, flagged by a lotus hash and a plume tag, to the same payer.
